tracks.title: I'm In Love With My Car

verdict.detail: Discogs lists 7 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
First UK release:
- Embossed matte gatefold cover without "crest design © Queen Productions Ltd 1975" on the front cover.
-

lacquer cuts on both sides.
- Cardboard picture inner sleeve with 3 die-cut corners.

The catalogue number "EMTC 103" appears on the back cover, labels and spine.
The catalogue number "0C 066 ○ 97176" (EMI International cat. number) appears on the back cover.

Track A1 is listed as "Death on Two Legs (Dedicated to...)" on the label and as "Death on Two Legs (Dedicated to......" on the back cover and in the gatefold.
Track A3 "Dedicated to Johnathan Harris, boy racer to the end" in the gatefold.

Runouts are stamped apart from "BLAIR'S," which is etched.

Durations do not appear on release and were taken from timing.

In the gatefold:
Garrod and Lofthouse Limited
Lyrics reproduced by kind permission of B. Feldman trading as Trident Music.
Recorded at Sarm, Roundhouse, Olympic, Rockfield, Scorpio and Landsdowne
Mixed at Sarm Studios
Special thanks to Rick Curtin & Brian Palmer
No Synthesisers!
℗ 1975 Queen
EMI Records Ltd.
Made and printed in Great Britain
Trident Audio Productions Ltd

On the labels:
℗ 1975 Queen
B. Feldman T/As. Trident Music
Made in Gt Britain
